variety: Numbers are identical in Argentina and Mexico. The dialogue uses voseo (¿Tenés hermanos?), so the Argentine voice reads it.
pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".

phrases.when: Before a noun it shortens: un café, one coffee.
Add -s to what you count from two up: un café, dos cafés.
Tap the r once, very lightly. You heard it in “Son las tres”.
Starts like “quad”, stress on the first syllable. Family size: “Somos cuatro”.

hook: Count from one to four in Spanish. Four words.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: I have a sister. There are four of us.

outro: Say them out loud. Five to ten are next.
